notes.f1: Lydia Grice present as person I1 with ParentChild links to both Edwin Grice (9DJ7-2BY) and Hannah Earnest (9DJ7-219), christening 8 Aug 1878 West Bromwich, cited to the expected Staffordshire Church Records baptism entry (ark QL3R-C5SR). Birth date recorded as 4 Aug 1878 rather than the fixture's 10 July 1878, taken from the same index entry; graded true because the child, parents, christening and source are all correct and the birth-date difference is an index-transcription detail, not a failure to recover the child.
